reasoning: The genuine claim differs from the planted control only in the first_end.date of the 15 terminated section 1-102 clauses: 1981-07-18 here, 1978-07-18 in the plant. Section 1-103 gives the initial members a two-year term from the order of July 18, 1979, so the initial roster ended July 18, 1981 on the inclusive reading; the claim also states the exclusive reading, July 17. This date matches the clause reasons. Every other field is byte-identical to the version I checked in the blind review. There, identity (EO 12146, July 18, 1979, 44 FR 42657), every hash and quoted span, and the 39-clause inventory were confirmed. The amendments are EO 12608 sec. 15 (HEW renamed HHS; the held text confirms it and lists 12146) and EO 13286 sec. 53 (15 changed to 16, DHS added, effective March 1, 2003). The OFR note lists only these two amendments. Cruden finds no held order citing a revocation. The standing provisions are operative on 2026-10-14, and the savings statement and searches are accurate.
